## Verdict: REJECT (one verification-checklist FAIL — a diff-added docstring makes a universally-false idempotence claim; all 8 acceptance criteria are functionally met and every reviewer rates the code correct, so the block is a single trivial-to-fix prose defect)

## Issue Compliance
Reviewed against issue #259: Humanize table column headers and chart axis titles in query result widgets — criteria from the issue body's Acceptance Criteria; scope unchanged. Requirement-based checklist items are included in the verification results below. This PR has no workpad criteria to use, so the issue body's `## Acceptance Criteria` section supplied them. All 8 acceptance criteria (VC-1..VC-8) are functionally satisfied by the shipped code and covered by tests.

## Verification Checklist Results
15 passed, 1 failed, 0 inconclusive — 0 via lite probe, 16 via agent.

The idempotence conclusion (AC #8) still holds — but not via the stated mechanism. inaccuracy_scope=source_authored_text, so it is NOT wording-only-normalizable and stands as a FAIL. ## Code Review Findings
### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor
1. `_humanize_label` docstring makes an over-broad universal claim: "a humanized label always contains a space or an uppercase letter." False for pure-digit / digit-led single words (e.g. `"2024"` -> `"2024"`). Idempotence still holds, but the stated reasoning does not. (raised by 1/5 agents) [inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: internal private-function docstring in src/sqllens/tools/_format.py, no tool parses it, not shipped to any external consumer] — behavior-inert prose cap capped this Phase-3 finding at Suggestion; the same defect drives the REJECT through the verification-checklist FAIL VC-9, not through the self-contradicting-diff carve-out.
2. `_ACRONYMS` comment (lines 17-21) is provenance/worked-example content rather than naming the specific wrong change to prevent (prevention-only comment standard). (raised by 1/5 agents)
3. `_default_axis_label` non-dict and missing/empty-field early-return branches are untested. (raised by 1/5 agents)
4. Truncation binary-search path with `column_labels` present (payload over the byte ceiling) is untested. (raised by 1/5 agents)
5. HTML widget header-label fallback is unverified — no JS test harness in the repo. (raised by 1/5 agents)
6. CSV export header stays raw while the on-screen header is humanized — by design (round-trip fidelity, consistent with AC #6); noted for intent confirmation, no change required. (raised by 1/5 agents)

## Verdict Criteria
- Any FAIL in verification checklist -> REJECT. VC-9 is a FAIL (source_authored_text, non-normalizable), so Phase 4.2 rule 1 fires: REJECT.
- No review-agent finding at or above the `critical` threshold (all six findings are Suggestion). The docstring documented_falsehood is behavior-inert (internal docstring, no tool/consumer reads it), so the behavior-inert prose cap caps it at Suggestion and it does not drive a threshold-independent self-contradicting-diff-carve-out REJECT.
- Net: the sole blocker is VC-9. Recommended fix: soften the `_humanize_label` docstring's idempotence justification (e.g. "...contains a space or an uppercase letter, or maps to itself, so feeding it back returns it as-is") so the stated reason is true for pure-digit tokens. This clears VC-9 with no code change. The remaining five findings are optional follow-ups (no functional impact).
